description:
Configure the request notification rules in ServiceDesk Plus to match the new company policy. 

Log in as 'administrator' / 'administrator'. Navigate to Admin > Notification Rules (under Helpdesk/Email Settings). 

Configure the 'Request' module rules exactly as follows:

1. Request is created:
   - Notify Requester: YES
   - Notify Technician: YES

2. Technician is assigned:
   - Notify Requester: YES
   - Notify Technician: YES

3. Request has been picked up:
   - Notify Requester: NO
   - Notify Technician: NO

4. Request is resolved:
   - Notify Requester: YES
   - Notify Technician: NO

5. Request is closed:
   - Notify Requester: NO
   - Notify Technician: NO

Ensure you SAVE your changes. Take a screenshot of the final configuration saved to /tmp/notification_rules_final.png.
